open_gates.owner: Actual alpha testers and owner reviewing reports
open_gates.closure_criteria: Run all twelve canonical cases on a real user device; record case, exact build SHA, browser/device, observed result, notes, and sanitized evidence. Human outcomes stay separate from automation.

open_gates.requirement: Physical Android rendering and touch behavior
open_gates.closure_criteria: Use the same-device loopback guide on Android Chrome; record model, Android version, Chrome version, actual viewport, and real touch outcomes. Do not infer from desktop emulation.
Approve the exact deployed notice; attach reviewer and date; describe only verified collection, use, retention, and deletion limits.
